about: Reading ladder for Pocket: public-domain books, easiest first, about 530,000 words for the 365-day plan. Texts copied from the owner's Bo-ok project (cleaned Project Gutenberg transcriptions; all authors died more than 70 years ago). Levels are rough estimates for a learner, not official CEFR ratings.

books.note: English translation by George Makepeace Towle (1873)
